inclusions.text: Private, air-conditioned transfer between Luxor Airport and your hotel
inclusions.source: A private, air-conditioned transfer between Luxor Airport and your hotel — with a rep on the ground from the moment you land.

inclusions.text: Representative meets you at the exit gate
inclusions.source: It is a private airport-to-hotel run in Luxor, handled by a representative who meets you at the exit gate and puts you in an air-conditioned vehicle before the city's heat has a chance to disorient you.

inclusions.text: Meet and greet with a name sign
inclusions.source: Once you have cleared the exit gate, look for a representative holding a sign with the Travel2Egypt name and your own.

inclusions.text: Private vehicle; the driver will handle your luggage
inclusions.source: The vehicle is private — you are not sharing with other passengers — and the driver will handle your luggage.

exclusions.text: The transfer does not stop at any of the temple sites
exclusions.source: The transfer does not stop at any of them.
A purely practical transfer — no monuments, no commentary, just a clean handover from terminal to hotel.
